name: PT Megapolitan Developments Tbk
summary: PT Megapolitan Developments Tbk operates as a property development company in Indonesia. The company develops and sells apartments, housing, shophouses, and kiosk units projects. It is also involved in renting properties and sale of land. The company was formerly known as PT Megapolitan Developments Corporation and changed its name to PT Megapolitan Developments Tbk in 2010. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia. PT Megapolitan Developments Tbk is a subsidiary of PT. Cosmopolitan Persada Developments.
